purpose: Pre-publish safety checklist for human reviewer. Every item must be ticked before manual posting.

global_checklist.item: No review item has been auto-posted
global_checklist.verification: Check published_externally counter in x-human-review-pack.json (should be 0)

global_checklist.item: No X API call has been made
global_checklist.verification: Search git log for 'api.twitter.com' or 'api.x.com' (should be empty)

global_checklist.item: No baoyu-post-to-x call has been made
global_checklist.verification: Search git log for 'baoyu-post-to-x' (should be empty in new commits)

global_checklist.item: No model call has been made
global_checklist.verification: Check model_call_status fields (should all be not_called or absent)
Check image_url fields (should all be Phase 6B pre-existing URLs)
No systemd / cron / setTimeout changes in git diff

global_checklist.item: No Telegram digest has been sent
global_checklist.verification: No telegram-send in recent logs (except the final Phase 6D report)

items: Verify the topic / title / hashtag in the linked content pack
Confirm the post's framing matches the content pack
Verify all hashtags are accurate
Post text is in Chinese with English topic name — confirm acceptable
Question-style ending is intentionally engaging — confirm acceptable
No aggressive marketing language
Confirm the image is visually appropriate for the topic
Read the image review note (review_url)
Confirm the image does NOT misrepresent the topic
linked_content_pack URL is the canonical content pack page
If adding a link in the X post reply, use linked_content_pack URL
gallery_url points to the same image (no broken alt-text)
No personal data (PII) of the topic's authors / creators / founders
No proprietary research / business data beyond public sources
No internal company strategy
No screenshots that include private dashboards
Reviewed by: __________________ (name)
Decision: APPROVE / EDIT / REJECT (circle one)

manual_publish_steps.action: Click 'Post' to open the new post composer
Paste the X Post Text block (exactly as shown in the review markdown)
Click the image icon and upload the image from image_url (download first if needed)
After posting, mark publish_status: published in a future review JSON. Do NOT change this file.

do_not_do: Do NOT call any model (LLM, image, video, music)
Do NOT start any timer / cron / systemd unit
Do NOT send any Telegram digest
Do NOT modify any .env / .control.local / control-action-audit.jsonl file
Do NOT overwrite any daily-digest.md / telegram-digest.txt / status.json file
